objective: Validate OmniLink Content-Length before use so a malformed or over-limit header becomes a typed integration failure instead of an escaping ValueError or OverflowError.
decision_supported: May a header from an untrusted server raise a standard-library exception through this client? No: the caller is promised OmniLinkError.
acceptance: An over-limit Content-Length still raises OmniLinkResponseTooLarge.
stop_conditions: The change would need an OmniLink API change.
risks_and_fallbacks: Refusing a missing Content-Length would break chunked responses; absence is still allowed and the body is bounded on read.
